residual_findings.title: Regression-of-resolution: R-V156P0-M004 prior resolution did not hold
residual_findings.description: R-V156P0-M004 (blocking sync I/O in the async fs/* handler) was marked lifecycle:resolved in V1.58 (commit 764cee49), but execute_read_file still used std::fs::read_to_string on current main. V1.86 T5 (commit 42335a16) moved the fs read/write + path-guard canonicalize behind tokio::task::spawn_blocking and converted execute_* / admission_pipeline / validate_file_path to async.

resolution.reason: actually moved to spawn_blocking; prior resolution was insufficient

residual_findings.title: Regression-of-resolution: R-V157P1-W001 prior resolution did not fully hold
residual_findings.description: R-V157P1-W001 (privileged fs/* host-tool path coverage) was marked lifecycle:resolved in V1.58 (commit e78c9307), but the fs/* host-tool execution surface still lacked tests for sibling-prefix escape, symlink escape, and the worker-IPC caller path. V1.86 T4 (commit 0eb9aa4f) backfilled these (Batch 1 T1-T3 already covered ../ and absolute-path escapes).

resolution.reason: backfilled missing privileged-path coverage; prior resolution was insufficient

residual_findings.title: Manuscript body read still uses string-prefix path comparison (same class as Finding 3)
residual_findings.description: nexus.manuscript.body.read host tool uses abs_body_str.starts_with(&workspace_root) for the non-canonicalized branch — same path-traversal anti-pattern as Finding 3, in a nexus.* tool path outside V1.86 fs/* scope (spec §13). Remote vector closed by T1 so urgency reduced; latent local/agent-exploitable.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.87 P1 closed: nexus.manuscript.read_range handler (execute_manuscript_read_range) now delegates to resolve_guarded_path (3-step: must_exist determination -> resolve_guarded_path -> BadRequest->InvalidInput mapping). qc2 adversarial probing confirmed the sibling-escape is closed (all probes rejected by canonicalize + component-wise Path::starts_with). Regression test manuscript_read_range_rejects_sibling_escape_body_path reproduces the escape as failing-without-the-fix.

residual_findings.title: resolve_guarded_path_async runs twice per fs/* call
residual_findings.description: admission validate_file_path (must_exist=false) + execute_* (must_exist=true) both resolve; negligible for local single-user.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.88 P1 T4: removed Gate 3 validate_file_path call from admission_pipeline for fs/* tools. Gate 4 permissions.toml check remains. execute_read_file and execute_write_file now own the single resolve_guarded_path_async resolution before filesystem access. Error behavior preserved (BadRequest -> Forbidden { resource: "file" }). Regression tests added for fs/* in-bounds reads/writes and escape rejection. Commit e2463330.

residual_findings.title: DaemonApiConfig cloned per-request by axum State
residual_findings.description: Arc<...> wrapper would zero-cost; clone sites at router construction are one-time (confirmed), so impact is small.
residual_findings.closure_note: V1.88 P1 T5: create_router now wraps the incoming DaemonApiConfig in Arc::new internally; the public signature is unchanged. Both route_layer calls share the Arc via Arc::clone. require_api_key and require_allowed_origin extract State<Arc<DaemonApiConfig>>; field access works unchanged via Arc Deref. Test helper build_router updated to wrap its config in Arc. Commit 7f6eeea2.
